name: Layered Codecs
description: The neutral LayeredImage (pixel layers with offset, opacity, blend mode, visibility, clipping and a placed mask, nested groups, the merged composite) and CodecError; the PixelCodec protocol apps plug their PNG codec into, with RawPixelCodec as the lossless test stand-in; ZipStore, the stored-only zip container; the OpenRaster reader (StackXML, a small bounded stack.xml parser, with layer PNGs through the PixelCodec); the PSD and OpenRaster entry points and limits, stubs that throw unsupported until the remaining readers and writers land.
